description: This Java interface defines the domain service for handling savings account transactions within the Fineract microfinance platform. It includes method signatures for handling withdrawals, deposits, journal entries, dividend payouts, reversals, and holds related to savings accounts.

classes.name: SavingsAccountDomainService
classes.description: Interface defining operations related to savings account transactions such as deposits, withdrawals, file postings, and reversals.

methods.name: handleWithdrawal
methods.description: Handles withdrawal transactions for a savings account, including updating transactions and potential backdated processing.

methods.name: handleDeposit
methods.description: Handles deposit transactions for a savings account, including transfers and backdated transactions.

methods.name: postJournalEntries
methods.description: Posts accounting journal entries related to a savings account after transactions.

methods.name: handleDividendPayout
methods.description: Processes dividend payout transactions for a savings account.

methods.name: handleReversal
methods.description: Handles reversal of savings account transactions.

methods.name: handleHold
methods.description: Places a hold (lien) on a savings account, possibly related to a lien or collateral.
